card.name: Digits inside numbers and ranges
card.fires_on: Single digits within a number, mostly the upper end of a range after "to" or the second digit of a round number like 100. Seen in doses, rates and section numbers.

card.writes: Promotes digit zero tokens, so it favors a following digit or zero in the number.
card.plain: It lights up on a digit partway through a number, especially the second figure in a range like 1 to 10.
